## A Rope Sliding Off a Table

A uniform rope lies on a frictionless table, part of it hanging over the edge. Let go, and it slides off.

**Predict:** Make the rope heavier — same length, same fraction hanging over the edge. Does it slide off faster, slower, or at the same rate?

options.text: Faster — more weight means more force.
Slower — more mass means more inertia to overcome.
At the same rate — the mass cancels out.
